description: Production release-musl A/B/C/A comparison: unchanged production, queued-ACK loss protection, queued-ACK plus PMTU-only capacity-sample exclusion, then production again. No temporary diagnostic logging or earlier pruning/rolling/packing/per-grant experiments in these binaries. 20s per ascending rate +2s receiver drain; fresh daemons per phase. Eight workers/lanes per endpoint,16 QinQ flows,1522-byte frames,innerMTU1500,44-segment UDP input,TAPqueue500,activePMTU discovery capped at1452-byteUDP. Routed path adds2250us per direction with zero injected loss; loopback has neither. CPU covers send interval; counter deltas include drain; gauges are absolute endpoint/worker snapshots.
